ICS 59.140.35CHD 17Revised Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPEThis standard prescribes the requirements of leather gauntlets and mittens for workers in the iron and steel industry and welders while handling moderately hot materials, or materials having rough and sharp edges, and during gas/electric welding or cutting.2. REFERENCESThe standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this Indian Standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of these standards.
